resources.string: Last trip home leaves at ⁨%1$s⁩ from ⁨%2$s⁩: leave now

On an evening away from Home, a notification 30 minutes before you need to leave for the last trip home. Checked once an evening (19:00 Sun–Thu, 12:00 Friday, 20:00 Saturday) from today\'s trips and where the app last saw you open. No location in the background. At most 3 searches an evening.
Set one of your saved places as Home (below) for the alert to work.
The alert arrives as a notification, so Android will ask you to allow notifications for this app. Nothing else is asked for.
Notifications are blocked for this app, so the alert stays off. Allow them in the phone\'s settings, then turn it on here.
